body_lead: Kerala first state in India to appoints Artificial Intelligence minister Last updated: May 21, 2026 | 18:33 PK Kunhalikutty will also oversee key sectors such as commerce, start-ups, mining, geology, and handlooms. Photo / X Ashraf Padanna, Correspondent Kerala has become the first state in India to establish a dedicated cabinet-level portfolio focused on Artificial Intelligence (AI). Officials said the decision highlights the state's commitment to integrating emerging technologies into governance and modernising public policy initiatives.
